title: Key to Cazador's Dungeon
summary: Unlocks the lower Crypt Gate to the Gloomy Ascent, a route to the Lower City Sewers.

fields.Unlock: The gate at X −1981, Y 843 opens from the dungeon side. The alternative is a DC 30 Sleight of Hand check.
fields.Acquisition: Find a copy on a charred goblin in the Grand Chamber at X −1924, Y 881, or on the floor of the treasure room in the Szarr Palace attic at X −758, Y 1080.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
